notes:
## B2B Demo Lead Rescue Desk: Enrich, Score, Route, and SLA Escalate

### How it works

This workflow receives website demo, quote, and integration leads, normalizes inconsistent form payloads, enriches the submitted page context, scores buyer intent, assigns an SLA and owner, logs the lead to Google Sheets, routes Gmail alerts, and returns a structured webhook response.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Lead Intake Webhook URL in your website form or lead capture tool.
- Replace placeholder Google Sheets credentials, sheet ID, and recipient Gmail addresses.
- Test with one hot lead, one review lead, one normal lead, and one missing-contact payload.
- Confirm SLA buckets, owner team routing, dedupe keys, and escalation terms match your sales process.

### Customization

Adjust scoring keywords, budget/timeline rules, recipient lists, and executive escalation thresholds to match your actual sales handoff.

## Receive and validate lead

Accepts the incoming website lead webhook, normalizes common form field variants, scores contact quality, and rejects submissions that do not include a usable reply path.

## Score and audit lead

Fetches submitted-page context, extracts title and meta signals, combines page intent with message, budget, timeline, and integration keywords, builds a dedupe key, and appends a complete audit row to Google Sheets.

## Reject missing contact

Builds a clear missing-contact response and returns it through the webhook branch before the workflow spends time on enrichment, Sheets logging, or alerts.

## Evaluate routing decisions

Routes hot, review, and normal leads to different alert payloads, then checks whether high-priority leads also need executive escalation.

## Send alerts and response

Builds Gmail-ready messages for hot leads, review-queue leads, normal leads, and executive escalations, then returns a clean success payload to the website webhook caller.
